violation_type.title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §747.707)
violation_type.short_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, there was sufficient evidence that operation has not provided an incident report of a child walked out of an operation without caregiver notification to the child's parents.

finding_variants.text: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, there was sufficient evidence that operation has not provided an incident report of a child walked out of an operation without caregiver notification to the child's parents.
The Incident Report was not signed by the parent.

The standard was evaluated for standard investigation and is not compliant.  An incident/illness report form was not provided to Child Care Regulations to confirm that the primary caregiver shared an incident/illness report with the victim's parent.
Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, the operation failed to provide a parent with an incident report after their child had been injured.
The Incident Report was generated but not shared with the parent.
